create_csv_logger: create a CSVLogger instance that writes logging data to a CSV file in a given directory
write_csv_row: write a dictionary of key-value pairs as a new row to the CSV logger file
close_csv_logger: close the CSV logger file after flushing any buffered data to disk
flush_csv_logger: flush the CSV logger file buffer to ensure all pending writes are persisted
get_csv_file_path: get the file path string of the CSV file being written by the logger
